[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values and rational opponents. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bidding my value maximizes expected payoff regardless of others' actions. Deviating risks reducing winning gains or winning at a loss. Therefore I will bid my true value of 17. ]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy. Other rational bidders face the same logic, and because values are independently redrawn each round, there is no benefit to shading or overbidding. Ties are random but negligible given $0.1 increments. To maximize long-run profit and avoid the winner’s curse, I will bid my private value of $39. This guarantees I win whenever the second-highest value is below 39 and pay exactly that opportunity cost.]
